description_short.value: Global gold miner with ten operations in eight countries, including the Obuasi and Iduapriem mines in Ghana; incorporated in England and Wales.
description_short.source: Written by us from the AngloGold Ashanti plc Form 20-F for the year ended 31 December 2025

description_full.value: AngloGold Ashanti plc mines gold. It has ten continuing mining operations in eight countries across Africa, the Americas and Australia. In Africa these include the Obuasi and Iduapriem mines in Ghana, Siguiri in Guinea, Geita in Tanzania, Sukari in Egypt (added with the acquisition of Centamin in November 2024) and an interest in Kibali in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, which Barrick operates. The group was formed in 2004 by the merger of AngloGold and Ashanti Goldfields. In September 2023 it moved its domicile from South Africa to the United Kingdom. It is incorporated in England and Wales, with its registered office in London and its global headquarters in Greenwood Village, Colorado. Its primary listing is on the New York Stock Exchange (AU), with secondary listings on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange and A2X (ANG) and the Ghana Stock Exchange. On the GSE the plc's ordinary shares (AGA) and Ghanaian Depositary Shares (AAD, 100 to one share) began trading on 26 September 2023. It reports in US dollars and has paid quarterly dividends since 2025.
